system: Yakıt Ölçümü & Hava Emiş / Kam Mili Zamanlaması
symptoms: Inspect the wiring and connectors: The technician will check the wiring and connectors associated with the fuel shutoff valve circuit for any signs of damage or corrosion. They will also ensure that the connectors are securely plugged in.

Test the fuel shutoff valve: The technician may test the fuel shutoff valve to determine if it is functioning properly. This may involve applying battery voltage to the valve and observing the response.

Check the ECM: If the wiring and fuel shutoff valve are in good condition, the technician may need to check the ECM for any faults or programming issues. They may use a scan tool to access the ECM and retrieve any relevant fault codes or data.
